metadata.description: Infrastructure: 733 skyscrapers of 150 m or more mapped in Wikidata (CC0), extruded to their real height and colored by height class, opening over New York, the city with the most mapped towers; pan to Chicago, Hong Kong, Shenzhen or Dubai. The time slider adds towers by the year they opened (or began construction when no opening date is recorded; towers before 1930 appear from 1930); press Play to watch skylines rise.
